# PFO Heating & Air Conditioning

> Full-service HVAC, heating oil delivery, and home backup generator provider serving New Jersey and Pennsylvania with residential and commercial solutions.

PFO Heating & Air Conditioning (Princeton Fuel Oil) is a regional HVAC contractor and fuel delivery company operating throughout New Jersey and Pennsylvania, including Mercer County, Hamilton, Princeton, and surrounding areas. The company specializes in heating and cooling system installation, repair, maintenance, fuel oil delivery, and backup generator services with 24/7 emergency support.

## Key Topics

- HVAC Installation & Repair
- Heating Oil Delivery
- Emergency Service
- Residential & Commercial
- Carrier Systems
- Mitsubishi Ductless
- Home Backup Generators
- Service Plans & Maintenance
- Energy Efficiency
- New Jersey & Pennsylvania Service Area
- 24/7 Emergency Support
- Furnace & Boiler Repair
- Air Conditioning Systems
- Budget Fuel Plans
- Home Comfort Solutions

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.princetonfuel.com/services): Main services page covering fuel delivery, HVAC installation and service for home comfort
- [Heating Oil Delivery](https://www.princetonfuel.com/services/fuel-oil): Heating oil delivery service with competitive pricing, budget plans and online ordering in NJ and PA
- [HVAC Installation](https://www.princetonfuel.com/services/hvac-installation): HVAC installation services featuring Mitsubishi, Carrier and Energy Kinetics systems
- [Service Plans & Maintenance](https://www.princetonfuel.com/services/service-plans): HVAC maintenance and service plans for heating and cooling systems in NJ/PA
- [Home Backup Generators](https://www.princetonfuel.com/services/home-backup-generators): Generac backup generator installation and service for whole home power solutions
